summary: Regression sweep for the post-index-crash fork. Backend health, auth, Excel report reconciliation (2026-01..09), imported piutang/hutang totals & aging, imports preview + commit idempotency, POS cash + credit checkout (credit -> AR -> return voids AR), partial installment payment idempotency + overpayment rejection, and RBAC all verified. Frontend login, dashboard, Laporan Excel, Piutang & Hutang, and Impor pages all render correctly with Indonesian rupiah values matching the spreadsheet targets.
action_items: None — all 21 backend tests pass and frontend flows are green.
Consider adding GET /api/receivables/{id} for easier single-item lookup (currently list-only).
Note: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py had a stale admin password ('admin123'); corrected to match /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: Session cookie is Secure=true in backend/.env; tests hitting http://localhost:8001 must extract cookie manually — worked around in test client but future test authors should be aware.
Imports preview shape returns per-group counts under summary.<group>.{total,ready,blocked} (not top-level ready/blocked); documented in test.
POS credit sale requires due_date — validation error message is clear and appropriate.
Receivable pay endpoint requires payment_date; consider defaulting to today() to reduce client friction.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed product, customer, and two credit transactions (cleaned up via /transactions/{id}/return where possible). Products deleted in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest is configured with `-n 2 --dist loadscope`. To run this suite serially use `-n 0`. Cookie is Secure so http://localhost tests must copy cookies manually. Excel reports reconcile 0.0 on preview for 2026-01..09 (store) and 2026-08 (september). Imported: 24 receivables (remaining=65,844,000), 39 payables (remaining=829,751,449). September commit is idempotent — recommit does not create duplicates. Credit sale flow: POST /transactions {payment_method:'credit', due_date required} -> creates AR with status 'open'; POST /transactions/{id}/return sets AR to 'void' (not 'paid'). Partial payment via POST /receivables/{id}/pay {amount, request_id, payment_date}; idempotent on request_id; overpayment => 422. Kasir role gets 403 on /excel/reports and /imports/preview.
rca of the issue: N/A — no product bug. The prior startup index crash referenced in the request was already fixed by the main agent; backend is healthy and all target metrics reconcile.
